youtube_title: Neon Drift: The Reinforcement Learning Hyperloop Race (Live ML Visualization)
youtube_description:
Welcome to Neon Drift—an adrenaline-fueled reinforcement learning race where agents learn to navigate a hyperloop track with shifting gravity fields and surprise obstacles. Watch competitors learn, adapt, and sprint toward maximum reward as the environment mutates every second.

In this video/visualization, we pit classic and modern RL approaches against a constantly changing world:
- DQN
- PPO
- Double DQN
- SARSA
- A3C
- MAML
- World Models

Comment your pick for the winner and tell us which learning strategy surprised you most!
